<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>

<title>Library Webpage</title>

<style>

body{
font-family:Arial;
background:#f2f2f2;
}

.card{
width:700px;
margin:auto;
margin-top:40px;
padding:20px;
background:white;

border-radius:10px;

box-shadow:0px 0px 10px gray;
}

table{
width:100%;
border-collapse:collapse;
margin-top:20px;
}

table,th,td{
border:1px solid black;
padding:10px;
text-align:center;
}

th{
background:#4CAF50;
color:white;
}

img{
width:120px;
border-radius:10px;
}

input{
padding:8px;
margin-top:10px;
width:200px;
}

button{
padding:8px 15px;
background:#4CAF50;
color:white;
border:none;
cursor:pointer;
border-radius:5px;
}

#result{
margin-top:15px;
font-size:18px;
font-weight:bold;
}

</style>

<script>

function calculateFine(){

let days=parseInt(document.getElementById("days").value);

let fine=0;

switch(true){

case(days<=5):
fine=days*2;
break;

case(days>5 && days<=10):
fine=days*5;
break;

default:
fine=days*10;
}

document.getElementById("result").innerHTML=
"Book Fine = ₹" + fine;

}

</script>

</head>

<body>

<div class="card">

<h2 align="center">Library Information</h2>

<table>

<tr>
<th>Book Image</th>
<th>Book Name</th>
<th>Author</th>
</tr>

<tr>
<td>
<img src="https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71h5wiKvILL._SL1400_.jpg">
</td>
<td>Java Programming</td>
<td>James Gosling</td>
</tr>

<tr>
<td>
<img src="https://th.bing.com/th/id/OIP.VhQFJnP6Tg3OdN68nBZOAwHaLG?w=204&h=306&c=7&r=0&o=7&dpr=1.3&pid=1.7&rm=3">
</td>
<td>Python Basics</td>
<td>Guido van Rossum</td>
</tr>

<tr>
<td>
<img src="data:image/webp;base64,">
</td>
<td>Web Development</td>
<td>David Flanagan</td>
</tr>

</table>

<br>

Enter Late Days:

<br>

<input type="number" id="days">

<button onclick="calculateFine()">
Calculate Fine
</button>

<p id="result"></p>

</div>

</body>
</html>
